import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int totalComponents, totalPersons, MOD;
    static int[][] binomial;
    static boolean[] visitedStates2;
    static ResData[] cacheStates2;
    static boolean[][] visitedStates1;
    static ResData[][] cacheStates1;

    static class ResData {
        int waysCount, sumAdd;
        ResData() {
            this.waysCount = 0;
            this.sumAdd = 0;
        }
        ResData(int w, int s) {
            this.waysCount = w;
            this.sumAdd = s;
        }
    }

    static int sumInterval(int a, int b) {
        return (a + b) * (b - a + 1) / 2;
    }

    static ResData computeStates2(int n) {
        if (n == 1) return new ResData(2, 0);
        if (visitedStates2[n]) return cacheStates2[n];
        ResData result = new ResData(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            int leftSize = i;
            int rightSize = n - i - 1;
            ResData leftRes = (leftSize == 0) ? new ResData(1, 0) : computeStates2(leftSize);
            ResData rightRes = (rightSize == 0) ? new ResData(1, 0) : computeStates2(rightSize);
            int totalWays = (leftSize + 1) + (rightSize + 1);
            int totalSum = sumInterval(0, leftSize) + sumInterval(0, rightSize);
            int mlt = binomial[leftSize + rightSize][leftSize];
            result.waysCount = (int)((result.waysCount + (long)leftRes.waysCount * totalWays % MOD * rightRes.waysCount) % MOD);
            result.sumAdd = (int)((result.sumAdd + (long)leftRes.sumAdd * totalWays % MOD * rightRes.waysCount
                         + (long)leftRes.waysCount * totalSum % MOD * rightRes.waysCount
                         + (long)leftRes.waysCount * totalWays % MOD * rightRes.sumAdd) % MOD);
        }
        visitedStates2[n] = true;
        cacheStates2[n] = result;
        return result;
    }

    static ResData computeStates1(int index, int count) {
        if (totalComponents - index == count) return computeStates2(count);
        if (visitedStates1[index][count]) return cacheStates1[index][count];
        ResData res = new ResData(0, 0);
        for (int i = index; i < totalComponents; ++i) {
            int leftCount = i - index;
            int rightCount = count - leftCount;
            if (rightCount < 0 || rightCount > totalComponents - i - 1) continue;
            ResData leftRes = (i == index) ? new ResData(1, 0) : computeStates2(leftCount);
            ResData rightRes = (i + 1 == totalComponents) ? new ResData(1, 0) : computeStates1(i + 1, rightCount);
            int mlt = binomial[leftCount + rightCount][leftCount];
            res.waysCount = (int)((res.waysCount + (long)leftRes.waysCount * rightRes.waysCount % MOD * mlt) % MOD);
            res.sumAdd = (int)((res.sumAdd + (long)leftRes.sumAdd * rightRes.waysCount % MOD * mlt
                      + (long)leftRes.waysCount * rightRes.sumAdd % MOD * mlt) % MOD);
        }
        visitedStates1[index][count] = true;
        cacheStates1[index][count] = res;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int ncomp = sc.nextInt();
        int npers = sc.nextInt();
        MOD = sc.nextInt();

        totalComponents = ncomp;
        totalPersons = npers;

        binomial = new int[ncomp + 1][ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            binomial[i][0] = 1;
            binomial[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; ++j) {
                binomial[i][j] = (binomial[i - 1][j - 1] + binomial[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }

        visitedStates2 = new boolean[ncomp + 1];
        cacheStates2 = new ResData[ncomp + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            cacheStates2[i] = new ResData();
        }

        visitedStates1 = new boolean[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        cacheStates1 = new ResData[ncomp + 1][npers + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= npers; ++j) {
                cacheStates1[i][j] = new ResData();
            }
        }

        System.out.println(computeStates1(0, npers).sumAdd);
        sc.close();
    }
}
